pwsbuilder July 31, 2018

Would you like to talk art with a master artist? Join Paul Hammersten who will spend the day, Saturday, August 4 discussing such questions as: What is art? Can creating art be a labor of love? Can one put a price on art that is a work of love? So you want to be an artist. How do you begin to be one? What is a ‘Master Artist’? He’ll also answer questions you have in this free informal session at The Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists. Drop in anytime between 10 AM and 4 PM.

The Art Gallery (source page unavailable) is located at 551 Main Street (Rte. 28) in Harwich Port, (508) 432-1012. Free parking across the street at the Harwich Chamber of Commerce Visitors Information Center.
